rationale: CD-0006 as agreed: the KG states facts only, with no policy filter and no verdict fields; a chain of monotone annotator modules, one predicate per rule with its own confidence, reason and boundary tests, marks edges; the pruned graph is the projection of unmarked edges and reconciliation asserts they agree. Annotators are order-independent because each reads source evidence, not another annotator's marks.
subject: P-28
title: Pruning is post-processing: one module per rule, annotated graph plus pruned projection
